function: Detection and prediction of LiDAR and RF-power blockages and anomalies with an unsupervised Bayesian network (IC-GDBN); not beam, waveform or resource design, so none of the seven areas (p. 3: "predict and detect both sensor and power blockages").
notes: Excluded for function (Step 1, code 5). The learned component (growing neural gas clustering and the IC-GDBN dictionary, unsupervised) is learned, and it does not act above the physical layer, but its task is blockage detection and anomaly detection from 3D LiDAR tracks and received RF power (p. 1 abstract: "predict various types of LiDAR and RF power blockages"; p. 3: "Instead of designing physical communication systems"). No precoder, beam, RIS configuration, waveform, or resource is learned or controlled; action selection is future work (p. 22: "this study establishes a foundational step toward active mitigation strategies"). It belongs to sensing and anomaly detection, not to any of the seven areas.
